# Security

To report a security problem in QuestPump (the add-on, QuestPump for Mac and Windows, the phone and watch apps or
questpump.com), email security@questpump.com, and keep it private until a fix is out.

The full policy, with what to include, when to expect an answer (within 5 working days; a fix or a plan within 30
days), the supported versions and how Pluxia GmbH handles a problem that is being actively exploited:
<https://questpump.com/security>.
